dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam. Before we start, all phones must be switched off. It's one of our group's rules.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm. bɪˈfɔːr wiː ˈstɑːrt, ˈɔːl ˈfoʊnz mʌst bi ˈswɪtʃt ˈɔːf. ɪts ˈwʌn əv aʊr ˈɡruːps ˈruːlz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry! Mine's off now. So, what's today's topic?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈsɑːri! ˈmaɪnz ˈɔːf ˈnaʊ. soʊ, ˈwʌts təˈdeɪz ˈtɑːpɪk?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Laws and regulations. Can you tell us about a law in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɔːz ənd ˌrɛɡjəˈleɪʃənz. kən juː ˈtɛl ʌs əˈbaʊt ə ˈlɔː ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. On motorcycles, helmets must be worn by everyone, even passengers.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ɑːn ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəlz, ˈhɛlmɪts mʌst bi ˈwɔːrn baɪ ˈɛvriwʌn, ˈiːvən ˈpæsɪndʒərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And do people obey that law?
dialogue.reading: ənd duː ˈpiːpəl oʊˈbeɪ ðæt ˈlɔː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not always. Lots of people break the law when they're only going a short distance.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɔːlweɪz. ˈlɑːts əv ˈpiːpəl ˈbreɪk ðə ˈlɔː wɛn ðɛr ˈoʊnli ˈɡoʊɪŋ ə ˈʃɔːrt ˈdɪstəns.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What happens if the police stop them?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈhæpənz ɪf ðə pəˈliːs ˈstɑːp ðɛm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They have to pay a fine. But I think the dangers should be explained in schools, too.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈhæf tə ˈpeɪ ə ˈfaɪn. bʌt aɪ ˈθɪŋk ðə ˈdeɪndʒərz ʃʊd bi ɪkˈspleɪnd ɪn ˈskuːlz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good point. And what about speed limits? Are they obeyed?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈpɔɪnt. ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈspiːd ˌlɪmɪts? ər ðeɪ oʊˈbeɪd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. Speed cameras can't be put on every road, so some drivers go really fast.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ˈspiːd ˈkæmərəz ˈkænt bi ˈpʊt ɑːn ˈɛvri ˈroʊd, soʊ sʌm ˈdraɪvərz ˈɡoʊ ˈriːli ˈfæst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is it legal to ride a motorcycle on the sidewalk?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈliːɡəl tə ˈraɪd ə ˈmoʊtərsaɪkəl ɑːn ðə ˈsaɪdwɔːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it isn't. But in traffic jams, some people do it anyway.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt. bʌt ɪn ˈtræfɪk ˌdʒæmz, sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈduː ɪt ˈɛniweɪ.
